canonical_example.text: Vivo con un miedo permanente a sufrir otro ataque de ansiedad.
canonical_example.translation: I live in constant fear of suffering another anxiety attack.

canonical_example.text: Las delegaciones de ambos países estarán reunidas en sesión permanente hasta alcanzar una resolución.
canonical_example.translation: The delegations of both countries will be in permanent session until they reach a resolution.

canonical_example.text: El peluquero me dijo que, a largo plazo, la permanente puede dañarte el pelo.
canonical_example.translation: My hairdresser told me that a permanent may damage your hair in the long term.

canonical_example.text: Yo creo que la permanente le va más a la forma de tu cara que el pelo liso.
canonical_example.translation: I think a perm goes better with your face shape than straight hair.

canonical_example.text: El gobierno designó una comisión permanente para la lucha contra el fraude.
canonical_example.translation: The government set up a standing commission against fraud.

canonical_example.text: Esta es la segunda permanente que me hago este año.
canonical_example.translation: This is the second time I've had my hair permed this year.

canonical_example.text: Hay muchos retratos en la galería.
canonical_example.translation: There are many portraits in the gallery.

canonical_example.text: La novela de Steinbeck es un retrato de familias migrantes de los años treinta.
canonical_example.translation: Steinbeck's novel is a portrayal of migrant families from the thirties.

canonical_example.text: Fue mi hermana quien se encargó de retratar a los novios.
canonical_example.translation: It was my sister who was in charge of photographing the bride and groom.

canonical_example.text: El paparazzi retrató al actor saliendo de la disco.
canonical_example.translation: The paparazzi took a picture of the actor leaving the club.

canonical_example.text: La retrató tendida sobre un sofá, llevando un vestido verde.
canonical_example.translation: He painted a portrait of her stretched out on a couch wearing a green dress.

canonical_example.text: Retrató a muchos miembros de la alta sociedad mexicana.
canonical_example.translation: He did portraits of many of the members of Mexican high-society.

canonical_example.text: La película retrata la sociedad de la época.
canonical_example.translation: The film portrays the society of the time.

canonical_example.text: El libro retrata a Colón como un hombre pragmático, dispuesto a cuestionarlo todo.
canonical_example.translation: The book depicts Columbus as a pragmatic man, prepared to question everything.

canonical_example.text: Lo retrató como una persona amable y comprensiva.
canonical_example.translation: She described him as a kind and understanding person.

canonical_example.text: La gente entonces solía ir a un fotógrafo profesional para retratarse.
canonical_example.translation: Back then people used to have their photograph taken by a professional photographer.

canonical_example.text: Los nobles se retrataban a menudo montados a caballo.
canonical_example.translation: The nobility often had their portraits painted riding a horse.

canonical_example.text: Creo que mi jefa quedó impresionada tras mi presentación.
canonical_example.translation: I think my boss was impressed with my presentation.

canonical_example.text: Me quedé impresionado al ver el cuerpo de las momias abrazándose.
canonical_example.translation: I was amazed when I saw the bodies of the mummies hugging.

canonical_example.text: Trabajé muy duro este mes para impresionar a mi nuevo jefe.
canonical_example.translation: I worked very hard this month to impress my new boss.

canonical_example.text: Me quedé realmente impresionada con todas las felicitaciones que me enviaron cuando me licencié.
canonical_example.translation: I was really moved by all the best wishes I received when I graduated.

canonical_example.text: Estoy muy impresionada de todo el apoyo que me mostraron mis colegas.
canonical_example.translation: I'm very touched by all the support my colleagues have shown me.

canonical_example.text: ¿No estás impresionada al ver lo grande que está tu nieto ya?
canonical_example.translation: Aren't you shocked to see how big your grandson is already?

canonical_example.text: La belleza de aquel sitio me impresionó.
canonical_example.translation: I was struck by the beauty of that place.

canonical_example.text: Esa historia triste que me contaste me impresionó mucho.
canonical_example.translation: That sad story you told me really moved me.

canonical_example.text: Me impresionó ver el estado en que quedó la casa después del incendio.
canonical_example.translation: I was shocked to see the state of the house after the fire.

canonical_example.text: Nos impresionó mucho la muerte de la hija de nuestros vecinos.
canonical_example.translation: We were deeply affected by the death of our neighbors' daughter.

canonical_example.text: Ahora que hemos impresionado la película, tenemos que procesarla.
canonical_example.translation: Now that we have exposed the film, we need to process it.

canonical_example.text: Me siento preparada y lista para impresionar en la entrevista.
canonical_example.translation: I feel ready and prepared to make an impression at the interview.

canonical_example.text: Eufemia se viste con ropa carísima, y nada más lo hace para impresionar.
canonical_example.translation: Eufemia wears really expensive clothes, and she does it just to impress.

canonical_example.text: Me impresioné al escuchar la voz tan linda que tiene Sonia.
canonical_example.translation: I was impressed when I heard Sonia's beautiful singing voice.

canonical_example.text: Carlos se impresionó mucho cuando vio las fotos de los desplazados.
canonical_example.translation: Carlos was very moved when he saw the photos of the refugees.

canonical_example.text: Me impresioné terriblemente al oír la mala noticia del terremoto.
canonical_example.translation: I was totally shocked when I heard the terrible news of the earthquake.

canonical_example.text: Cocino las recetas de mi madre cuando me hace falta mi patria.
canonical_example.translation: I cook my mother's recipes when I miss my homeland.

canonical_example.text: Se alistó cuando cumplió los 18 para poder defender su patria.
canonical_example.translation: He enlisted when he turned 18 so that he could defend his country.

canonical_example.text: Aunque lleva aquí desde que era niño, añora regresar a su patria.
canonical_example.translation: Although he's been here since he was a child, he yearns to return to the motherland.

canonical_example.text: No he regresado a la patria desde que huí de la guerra.
canonical_example.translation: I haven't returned to the fatherland since fleeing the war.

canonical_example.text: Desde niños nos enseñan a respetar los símbolos patrios.
canonical_example.translation: We are taught to respect the national symbols since we are children.

canonical_example.text: Siempre es reconfortante regresar al suelo patrio.
canonical_example.translation: It's always comforting to return to your native land.

canonical_example.text: Las guerras incesantes han hecho que muchas personas dejen su país patrio.
canonical_example.translation: The incessant wars have made many people leave their home country.

canonical_example.text: Estoy un poco preocupado si terminaré mi tesis antes de la fecha de entrega.
canonical_example.translation: I'm a little worried about whether I'll finish my thesis before the due date.

canonical_example.text: No hay nada de qué estar preocupado. La inyección solo dura un segundo.
canonical_example.translation: There is nothing to be concerned about. The shot only takes a second.

canonical_example.text: Me preocupa que no haya tenido noticias de tu hermano en una semana.
canonical_example.translation: I'm worried that I haven't heard from your brother in a week.

canonical_example.text: Nos preocupan los animales que vimos en la calle.
canonical_example.translation: We're concerned about the stray animals we saw on the street.

canonical_example.text: Parece que no le preocupa ganar dinero.
canonical_example.translation: He doesn't seem bothered about earning any money.

canonical_example.text: Mi papá se preocupa de todos menos de él mismo.
canonical_example.translation: My dad worries about everyone else except himself.

canonical_example.text: Preocúpate de llegar a tiempo y yo me preocupo de traer a la cumpleañera.
canonical_example.translation: You make sure to get there on time and I'll make sure to bring the birthday girl.
